title: Prove a uniform ceiling for three-cycle permutation-cut certificates
body:
The arbitrary-permutation-cut question left by #4968 and #4974 has a certified obstruction: for `t` coordinate-three-cycle targets, every nonnegative combination of register-independent permutation cuts has normalized value at most

`((27 + 9 sqrt(2))/7) t ≈ 5.675417 t`.

This holds for **every finite address dimension, every register count, arbitrary restored dirty spectators, and every finite permutation action**. Targets may use different triples and either orientation. Consequently the linear cut relaxation plus final rounding cannot certify the full `6t` direct tariff for `t >= 4`.

The constant is sharp for the real quadratic domination proved here. **The Boolean-cut optimum and the actual multi-target word minimum remain open.** This does not repeat #5005's exact two-register word search, prove shared paid work, or claim a new κ. Integer label-count constraints and stronger/nonlinear invariants are outside the obstruction.

The proof uses one exact identity in `Z[GL3(F2)]`, a written spectral argument and restriction to each target's embedded three-coordinate subgroup. The finite certificate is independently checked by row-bitset group-algebra convolution and by a separately implemented seven-point permutation representation on all 168 regular basis columns. No floating solver output is acceptance evidence.

Validation at `9ad4c47068f900fa1619191292539adcced0d638`, macOS arm64 / Python 3.12.12:

- Registered normal/optimized replays pass; exact identity and sharpness vectors agree. Also 144 binary paid cross-block checks, four dirty endpoints and all 32,768 cuts in a spectator-containing natural GL4 action.
- Twelve actual corrupted CLI runs are rejected; both inverse-cycle controls pass. Independent report-corruption checks remain active under `-O`.
- Committed-byte and full source-history checks pass. Official export integrity and all five Git-free replay commands pass with read-only package files and unchanged bytes across all eight exported files.
- Export SHA256: `59392219ed1e09f6e2637e5f7f469c6478f45f92502d1cd9426777aa60053888`.

[Hosted CI run 39919483551](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39919483551) also passed for the published head: onboarding/selection and the sole registered package replay, including its committed-input integrity check. This is implementation evidence, not independent scientific acceptance.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/three-cycle-cut-ceiling
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/three-cycle-cut-ceiling --check-source-history
```
